comparison.objective: Close a named ball valve, install a clamp-on lockout, and padlock it; candidate tunes and relocks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve rotation, lockout fitting, clamping, and padlock insertion versus hex-key seating, collar metering, counterholding, and torque-limited set-screw locking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct valve alone is closed and secured versus two acceptable impact cycles with bounded stroke, rebound, overload, and drift. No specs give detailed thresholds.
comparison.reason: Although both manipulate rotary hardware and a lock, valve isolation does not test iterative energy-absorption adjustment.
